note: Mobile fixes: chart on top via flexbox, perf via dropping width/height transitions on luminos sprites. Kirk hit a build on mobile where the chart was not first despite order:1 on chart-area. CSS Grid does honor order on items but mobile-browser auto-flow has historically been flakier than flexbox. Switched .main from grid to flex on mobile so chart-on-top is rock-solid. Also removed the width and height transitions on .tg-luminos sprites — they triggered a layout pass on every frame during the 600ms ramp, and --lum-energy updates on every renderChart so the two-sprite times two-property times 36-frame layout thrash was causing mobile slowdown. Color and filter transitions stay because they compose without layout. Size now updates discretely with analysis cadence which is already gentle.
